goal: Rewrite every Inner Life post for accuracy, substance, appropriate length and the calibrated site voice, then apply the religious reading layout and verify publication.
prose_count_method: Count decoded main content before the Sources section, including authored gallery cards once and excluding scripts, styles, SVG, noscript and navigation. Runtime explorer prose is reviewed separately in the meditation and cage audits and is not included in this uniform total.

verification_limits: Individual audits name the primary documents and passages actually read, and distinguish unavailable full texts, indexed excerpts, allegations, retrospective accounts and uncertain historical or scientific claims. No audit claims exhaustive access to every complete book.
publication: The repository publishes main through GitHub Pages. Completion requires committing the reviewed files, pushing main, and checking the live collection and article assets.

publication_integration.method: Applied the reviewed release onto current origin/main in a separate managed worktree, retaining both reader-note and explorer-note indexing and every other published search entry.
